acceptance: make pr-open or oracle planning detects a base sha that is not the merge base with origin/develop and either refreshes it or fails with a clear message
context:
2026-10-27: FREEZE LIFTED (owner 2026-10-27): the oracle-code merge freeze is removed; PRs merge on the normal rules (oracle SHIP on the exact head, threads answered and resolved, make pr-arm).

Workaround used: close and reopen. Evidence is a single occurrence.
description: PR #3109 (head a6acef0d9) was pushed after its branch had been merged with a newer develop. The GitHub API kept reporting an old base (base sha 27f7a7d1f, changed_files 481, additions 14532, 46 commits) while the real change against origin/develop was 11 files. gh pr diff failed with HTTP 406 (over 300 files) and the oracle planned tier very-high ('2247 code lines across 13 areas', soundness paths touched). After gh pr close then gh pr reopen the API reported base 0f5ed3aa7, 11 files, 4 commits and the oracle reported 'no soundness path changed'. Cause not established: it may be GitHub's lazy recomputation rather than anything BenchBox does. Related: oracle-coverage-gate-large-prs-20261017 covers oracle handling of genuinely large PRs; this item is about a wrongly large PR.
